verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe found a live llms.txt at docs.railway.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200). Railway also serves agent-oriented markdown docs such as agents.md and ai/mcp-server.md, including a skill that teaches coding agents how to operate Railway. missing for 10: no evidence about the depth or completeness of the llms.txt content (e.g. an llms-full.txt or full-doc coverage), and no independent user reports of agents using it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
